episodes.152711: Mid-level troughing advanced eastward across the region, with a frontal boundary to the north, keeping South Florida well within an unstable airmass. Several perturbations aloft brought cooler temperatures that aided in the potential for stronger convection. As daytime heating increased, storms developed across Palm Beach. Lightning from one of these storms that struck a home, causing damage. Thankfully, no injuries were reported.
episodes.152713: Mid-level troughing advanced eastward across the region, with a frontal boundary to the north, keeping South Florida well within an unstable airmass. Several perturbations aloft brought cooler temperatures that aided in the potential for stronger convection. As daytime heating increased, storms moved offshore, producing gusty winds over the Biscayne Bay waters.
episodes.153507: Tropical wave affected the area, with numerous shower and thunderstorm activity, especially across eastern PR. 2 to 4 inches of rain fell.
episodes.153893: On a day with rain and snow showers in the area, a waterspout occurred just west of the Mackinac Bridge, and within sight of the bridge.

events.narrative: Emergency managers reported flash flooding along Rio Blanco, particularly along road PR-31 intersection with exit 22.
A marine thunderstorm wind gust of 42mph/36 knot was measured by Wxflow Mesonet station XTKY at Turkey Point at 4:04 PM EDT.
Lightning struck a house at the intersection of Lucky Lane and Southridge Road in Delray Beach. There was some charring to the roof and attic as well as electrical damage.
A marine thunderstorm wind gust of a 39 mph/34 knot was measured by WxFlow Mesonet station XKBS at Biscayne Bay light at 4:44 pm EDT.
A marine thunderstorm wind gust of 41 mph/35 knot was measured by WxFlow Mesonet station XDIN at Dinner Key Light at 5:05 PM EDT.

A marine thunderstorm wind gust of 45 mph (39 knots) was measured by Weatherstem Mesonet station 0878w at the Frost Museum of Science in Downtown Miami on the Biscayne Bay shoreline. The anemometer is elevated about 70 feet above ground level.
